'''Fren Nurook''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. She lived in [[Glare Peak]] on [[Tivar II]] for five years, and was recruited by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Jaxon Brand]] after she was fired from [[Roskam Mechanized Systems]] for suspicion of Rebel sympathies.

She was one of the agents deployed to [[Rescue at Glare Peak|rescue]] downed Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fren was one of the pre-generated characters used in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' special promotion, ''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''.
